## The ecumenical Body

Convene or join Faith & Technology summits across traditions; build shared cross-denominational resource platforms; form united advocacy for ethical tech policy — data privacy, AI ethics, digital equality — as one Christian voice; launch a collaborative Christian innovation lab; join interfaith tech-ethics councils; coordinate global digital-missions efforts; and run ecumenical digital-literacy programs serving underprivileged communities first. What we do well must be shared with the full Body of Christ.
